name: Ishmael
bio:
Ishmael is the son born to Abram and Sarah's servant Hagar, Abram's firstborn son. God promised Hagar that Ishmael would become a great nation, describing him as one who "will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him" (Genesis 16:11-12). After Isaac was born, Ishmael mocked him, and Sarah demanded that he and his mother be sent away; though this grieved Abraham deeply, God promised to watch over and preserve them (Genesis 21:9-13).

Ishmael grew up in the wilderness and became an archer, later marrying an Egyptian woman and fathering twelve sons who became the heads of twelve tribes, fulfilling God's promise to make him a great nation (Genesis 17:20; 25:12-16). When Abraham died, Ishmael joined his half-brother Isaac in burying their father in the cave of Machpelah — showing that despite the family's earlier division, the two remained brothers by blood.
